# Support

- **Questions:** ask in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/cosminfuica/jobyssey/discussions).
- **Bugs:** open an issue with the [bug form](https://github.com/cosminfuica/jobyssey/issues/new/choose).
- **Feature ideas:** use the feature form on the same page.
- **Security issues:** follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Never post them in public.

There's no e-mail support.
